description: Get details for one model by owner/project/model, ul://owner/project/model, or slug with a project. Model quality (best epoch and fitness) is not included; use model_metrics, which validates the platform's best-epoch fields.

model.description: Model ref by owner/project/model, ul:// URI, or slug (requires project).

project.description: Project ref required when model is given by slug.

name: models_get
